title: A practical room-visualisation launch checklist
description: Before launch, check the theme embed, product selection, subscription, photo-upload flow, mobile layout and clear limits on what a generated image proves..
answer: Before launch, check the theme embed, product selection, subscription, photo-upload flow, mobile layout and clear limits on what a generated image proves. Test each product template rather than only the homepage.
body:
Test the whole customer path

Check installation, theme activation, billing, product selection, photo upload and the return to the product page. Repeat the check on your actual product templates and a narrow mobile viewport.

A practical review checklist

  • Enable and save the app embed in the correct theme.
  • Approve the intended subscription and review usage charges.
  • Test enabled and excluded products as configured in the app.
  • Keep measurements and delivery information beside the generated preview.
  • Check support and photo privacy guidance before launch.

AI-generated previews illustrate appearance and placement. They do not provide measured dimensions, guaranteed scale or a live camera-based AR view. Shoppers should check product measurements before buying.

Use the app’s documented workflow

Room Refresh is a Shopify app for furniture and home-decor merchants. Shoppers upload a room photo and generate a preview of a product in that space, directly from a product page.

Start with setup instructions, inspect the current product examples, and check plans and usage charges. Ask support about your specific store before treating an assumption as a product feature.
